    # [1]
    ActivatedAbility(
        cost=Cost(
            parts=(
                CostManaColor(color='G', amount=QConst(value=1)),
                CostManaColor(color='G', amount=QConst(value=1)),
                CostManaGeneric(amount=QConst(value=4)),
                CostTap(),

        ),
        effect=Seq(
            steps=(
                A(Verb.LOOK_AT, {'controller': ControllerRef.YOU, 'count': QConst(value=6)}),
                OptionalEffect(
                    inner=Seq(
                        steps=(
                            A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
                                'cards': Selector(
                                    count=QConst(value=1),
                                    mode=SelectorMode.ONE_OF,
                                    filter=FAnd(
                                        children=(
                                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                                            FNot(
                                                inner=FAtom(
                                                    pred=FAtomPred.QTY_GE,
                                                    count=QBin(
                                                        op=QBinOp.ADD,
                                                        left=QCount(
                                                            selector=Selector(
                                                                count=QUnbounded(),
                                                                mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
                                                                filter=FAnd(
                                                                    children=(
                                                                        FAtom(
                                                                            pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS,
                                                                            who=ControllerRef.YOU,
                                                                        ),
                                                                        FAtom(
                                                                            pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ,
                                                                            string_value='Land',
                                                                        ),
                                                                    ),
                                                                ),
                                                                zones=(
                                                                    Zone(
                                                                        kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD,
                                                                        controller=ControllerRef.ANY,
                                                                    ),
                                                                ),
                                                            ),
                                                        ),
                                                        right=QConst(value=1),
                                                    ),
                                                    field=QPropField.MANA_VALUE,
                                                ),
                                            ),
                                        ),
                                    ),
                                    zones=(
                                        Zone(
                                            kind=ZoneKind.LIBRARY,
                                            controller=ControllerRef.YOU,
                                            position=ZonePosition.TOP,
                                        ),
                                    ),
                                ),
                                'destination': Zone(
                                    kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD,
                                    controller=ControllerRef.YOU,
                                ),
                            }),
                            reveal_result(),
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
                A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
                    'arrange': 'RANDOM',
                    'cards': Selector(
                        count=QConst(value=1),
                        mode=SelectorMode.REST,
                        filter=FAnd(children=()),
                        zones=(
                            Zone(
                                kind=ZoneKind.LIBRARY,
                                controller=ControllerRef.YOU,
                                position=ZonePosition.TOP,

                    'destination': Zone(
                        kind=ZoneKind.LIBRARY,
                        controller=ControllerRef.YOU,
                        position=ZonePosition.BOTTOM,

                }),

    ),
    # [2]
    SpellAbility(kind=SpellKind.CREATURE),

clauses.clause: You may play an additional land on each of your turns.
{4}{G}{G}, {T}: Look at the top six cards of your library.
You may reveal a creature card with mana value less than or equal to the number of lands you control from among them and put it onto the battlefield.
Put the rest on the bottom in a random order.
